The '''New Quarter''' was one half of the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] city [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and consisted of newer buildings than the city's other side, the [[Old Quarter/Legends|Old Quarter]]. The gangster [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] resided there sometimes.
